text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Air Shakur, who achieved the Senior Spring Triple Crown
comprising the Osaka Hai, Tenno Sho (Spring),
and Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Riding that wave of momentum, the number of fans cheering for her seems to be skyrocketing...
choice_data_list: Talk about Air Shakur always gets everyone fired up, huh.
Talk about Air Shakur always gets everyone fired up, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Searching her name on social media brought up more and more posts,
and reactions to the Academy's announcements and articles were increasing too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Oh, really.
choice_data_list: Why not use this chance to socialize a bit?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm not.
Don't ask when you already know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As always, Air Shakur showed no interest in doing anything for her fans.
Right then, I stumbled upon an intriguing post online.

text_block_list.name: @Sha_sha_sha
text_block_list.text:
"Is it true Shakur is from an ex-noble family?
I kinda had a feeling.
She does seem classy (????)"

text_block_list.name: @onikudaisuki
text_block_list.text: "The concept of Air Shakur secretly being a foreign agent who saves the country from crisis night after night between races."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Completely baseless rumors about my background are circulating.
When I tell Air Shakur about this—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"It's only for now anyway.
I'll get bored soon enough."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Enjoy the show while you can.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur is also reluctant to do interviews,
so little is known about her details.
If left alone, speculations will only continue to spread.
choice_data_list: (I hope this doesn't turn into a huge scene...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And that moment arrived sooner than expected.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Prrrr...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Finding it unusual, I checked the phone to find what appeared to be her location data—and a message that simply read, 'Come.'"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —Hey, over here!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Idiot, keep your voice down!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, didn't you hear someone shouting
"Shakur" over that way just now?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Word is they're in front of the station, though!
Let's check over there!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*
Seriously annoying.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's a complete circus of idiots!
They're totally messing around with sightings of me!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I was just doing some normal shopping,
and someone took secret photos and posted them everywhere...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
They even slapped on dumbass rumors like,
"Shakur is rare, so catching her will level you up."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What, am I some kind of rare beast?!
Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A sighting occurred at the worst possible time,
just as rumors about Air Shakur were peaking,
and things blew up into a massive commotion.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ah, seriously so annoying.
Treating people like toys...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: How about I hack everyone's phones and totally tamper with all their data!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's understandable why Air Shakur is furious.
However, after checking, it seems some of the girls just wanted a chance to talk to her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Then we might be able to use this situation to our advantage for fan service. Hacking is completely out of the question, of course, but—
choice_data_list: Manipulating the information might be an option.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haaah!?
choice_data_list: Can you make multiple accounts right away?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"—'Shakur is at the park this time!?'
'Wait, someone just said she was eating snacks at the shopping district.'
'Could they be twins?' 'No, maybe a ninja...'"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, well,
you guys sure look hyped up.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh.
Things going just as planned feels so damn good, doesn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, I created multiple social media accounts to randomly spread fake sightings of her location. By throwing the situation into further chaos, it made it harder to pinpoint where she actually was.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Even though I put in my actual current location for them.
Someone already posted 'I'm giving up'.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, this'll blow over soon enough.
With this many locations leaked,
they can't go around crushing all of 'em.
choice_data_list: Even so, what if someone comes looking for it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Well... in light of that persistence, maybe I could entertain a little "mingling" with you, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Assumin' there was anyone with the guts to do that.
In the end, you just got dragged into trouble by folks who just wanted to stir shit up.
choice_data_list: I'm not so sure about that.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
You really are here...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um! That is...
I'm a huge fan of yours, Shakur-san...!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"I saw a post saying I might get to meet you, so I rushed over from my hometown...
and searched every single place it said you'd be!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Huh?
All of it?"

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! I'm an oshikatsu fan on my own, so...
I couldn't share info and had to check everywhere one by one...
But it's such a rare opportunity, I just had to come!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *gasp*...
I... I found... my light...

text_block_list.name: Fan E
text_block_list.text:
"No way!? She's really here...!
Wrecking my bike was totally worth it...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her fans certainly don't lack grit.
After all, they kept cheering for her even when
she was clearly not being acknowledged.
choice_data_list: If someone came looking for it... what was it again?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Damn.
So you're saying it's "just as planned"?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey! You, the first one who showed up.
Come here.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I ain't listening to any half-assed bullshit.
—Wrap it up in two minutes.
